why: In each row, figure 3 is figure 1 and figure 2 put together. Row 1: three triangles up + three triangles down. Row 3: dots over a line + a line over dots. Row 2 ends with two rows of three squares, and figure 1 is one row of three squares, so the middle figure is also three squares: option 2. Option 1 has four squares.
trick: Check if the last cell is the sum (overlay) of the first two cells.
